comparison.objective: Vent a pressure pan, then remove its lid and place it level on a trivet.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained button pressing plus knob grasping and level lid transport, not coaxial mandrel stabilization and hammer impact.
comparison.success_condition: Steam stops before the lid is lifted; lid ends flat and released. Candidate instead gates four fractures, fragment recovery, and insert/shell integrity.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-ordered venting and lid handling rather than insert tang removal.
